title: Ends in 01: guess where the 01 starts
notes: q0 reads anything and stays put. On each 0 the machine also guesses that the final 01 starts here and moves to q1 as well. A wrong guess dies at the next symbol. 1101 ends with q2 in the set and is accepted; on 0110 the last guess dies on the final 0.
ops: start q0; accept q2; q0 0,1 -> q0; q0 0 -> q1; q1 1 -> q2
